question_text: A 23-year-old woman presents to the outpatient OB/GYN clinic as a new patient who wishes to begin contraception. She has no significant past medical history, family history, or social history. The review of systems is negative. Her vital signs are: blood pressure 118/78 mm Hg, pulse 73/min, and respiratory rate 16/min. She is afebrile. Physical examination is unremarkable. She has researched multiple different contraceptive methods, and wants to know which is the most efficacious. Which of the following treatments should be recommended?
